cards.ex: Never mind, I found my keys.
Can we swap seats? → I dropped my phone. (swap A for B, drop 사람 off = 내려 주다)
She nodded and smiled. → Shut the window, please. (nod = yes의 몸짓, shut = close보다 센 느낌)
Do you like horror movies? — Not really.

quiz.q: Oh, ___ — I already sent the email.
quiz.note: Never mind = 됐어요/신경 쓰지 마세요. 부탁을 거둘 때 딱!

quiz.q: Could you ___ me off at the station?
quiz.note: drop 사람 off = 차로 내려 주다. 반대는 pick 사람 up!
I'm in = 나도 할게. 반대는 I'm out / Count me out.

quiz.q: He just ___ without saying a word.
quiz.note: nod = 고개 끄덕이다. nod off = 꾸벅꾸벅 졸다.

quiz.q: Are you hungry? — ___ , I had a late lunch.
quiz.note: Not really = 별로요. No보다 부드러운 거절!

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this.
Please accept my sincere apologies. → We did a thorough check. (sincere = 진심의, thorough = 빠짐없는)
As a rule of thumb, reply to emails within a day.
They compensated us for the delay. → The room can accommodate 50 people. (compensate 사람 for N, accommodate = 공간·요구를 받아 주다)
I don't have a plan for the trip — I'll just go with the flow.

quiz.q: The old approach failed, so let's ___ this time.
quiz.note: think outside the box = 틀 밖에서 생각하다. 회의에서 단골 표현!

quiz.q: He gave a ___ apology, and I believed him.
quiz.note: sincere = 진심의. 편지 끝 Sincerely도 여기서!

quiz.q: As a ___ , spend no more than 30% of your income on rent.
quiz.note: rule of thumb = 대략적인 기준. as a rule of thumb로 문장 시작.

quiz.q: The airline ___ us for the lost luggage.
quiz.note: compensate 사람 for N = ~에 대해 보상하다. 명사 compensation.

quiz.q: Don't stress about the schedule — just ___ .
quiz.note: go with the flow = 상황에 맡기다. 여유로운 사람의 한마디!

cards.expr: Get a taste of your own medicine
cards.ex: He's always late, so we made him wait — a taste of his own medicine.
Fax machines are obsolete. → It's a lucrative business. (obsolete ↔ up-to-date, lucrative = profitable)

cards.expr: Have a lot on your plate
cards.ex: I can't take that on — I have a lot on my plate right now.
He conceded that I had a point. → She refuted the claim with data. (concede that ~, refute a claim)
I was looking up one word and went down a rabbit hole for an hour.

quiz.q: She kept interrupting everyone, so we interrupted her — she got ___ .
accept: a taste of her own medicine
quiz.note: a taste of one's own medicine = 자기가 한 대로 당하기. give 사람 a taste of their own medicine.

quiz.hint: 더 이상 안 쓰는, 구식의 (o로 시작)
quiz.note: obsolete = 기술 발전으로 쓸모없어진. become obsolete.

quiz.q: I'd love to help, but I ___ this month.
accept: have a lot on my plate
have too much on my plate
have so much on my plate
quiz.note: have a lot on one's plate = 일이 너무 많다. 정중한 거절에 좋아요.

quiz.q: The lawyer ___ every point the witness made.
quiz.note: refute = 증거로 반박하다. 그냥 '부인'은 deny, 반박은 refute.

quiz.q: I started researching one topic and ___ for hours.
quiz.note: go down the rabbit hole = 끝없이 빠져들다. 앨리스에서 온 표현!
